versions.content: If the configured ComSignalDataInvalidValue (ECUC_Com_00391) is received for a signal and the ComDataInvalidAction (ECUC_Com_00314) is configured to REPLACE for this signal, the AUTOSAR COM module shall replace the signal’s value by its configured ComSignalInitValue (ECUC_Com_00170). After the replacement, the normal signal processing like filter- ing and notification shall take place as if the ComSignalInitValue would have been received instead of the ComSignalDataInvalidValue.
